designs.title: Contour Pareidolia — High Desert
designs.descriptionHtml:
A dense topographic study in sun-baked terracotta. Fine elevation lines trace three overlapping ridges, like a survey map of country that doesn't exist.

One of five in-house designs built from the Contour Pareidolia shader — buy it as-is, or open the customizer and make it yours.

designs.title: Contour Pareidolia — Caldera
designs.descriptionHtml:
Concentric rings of heat around a sunken core — a volcanic crater rendered as pure elevation data, in inferno reds and molten golds.

One of five in-house designs built from the Contour Pareidolia shader — buy it as-is, or open the customizer and make it yours.

designs.title: Contour Pareidolia — Interference
designs.descriptionHtml:
Two equal peaks whose contour fields collide and merge, like ripples meeting in a wave tank — mapped in deep ocean blues and teals.

One of five in-house designs built from the Contour Pareidolia shader — buy it as-is, or open the customizer and make it yours.

designs.title: Contour Pareidolia — Abyss
designs.descriptionHtml:
Inverted terrain: two deep basins plunge below the surface, traced by sparse, bold contour lines in bioluminescent greens. A scratched, weathered finish gives it the feel of a recovered deep-sea chart.

One of five in-house designs built from the Contour Pareidolia shader — buy it as-is, or open the customizer and make it yours.

designs.title: Contour Pareidolia — Aurora Summit
designs.descriptionHtml:
A full elevation sweep through the aurora gradient — mint at the valley floor climbing through cyan and violet to magenta at the summit, finished with a fine halftone dot grid.

One of five in-house designs built from the Contour Pareidolia shader — buy it as-is, or open the customizer and make it yours.
